title: Fix Aarti Section Error — Aartis Not Displaying

requirements.text: Fix the Aarti section (frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx) so that all aartis from static data (frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts) are correctly loaded and displayed as cards when the section is opened. The page must not show an error on load and must render all available aarti entries on all devices.

quotes: Sabhi device me aaraha hai kholte hi aarti nahi dikhti sirf aat hai error

acceptanceCriteria: Opening the Aarti section does not display any error message.
All aarti entries from staticData.ts are rendered as AartiCard components on the page.
The fix works on all devices and browsers.
Clicking an aarti card navigates to the correct AartiDetail page.
No console errors related to aarti data loading or rendering.

requirements.text: Add a graceful empty state UI to the Aarti section (frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx) in case no aarti data is available, showing a friendly Hindi message instead of an error or blank screen.

quotes: kholte hi aarti nahi dikhti sirf aat hai error

acceptanceCriteria: If no aarti data is available, a friendly message is shown instead of an error.
The empty state does not crash the app or show a raw error.

constraints: Do not create a new app — fix the existing Aarti section only.
Do not modify any immutable frontend paths (hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, hooks/useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui).
Do not change the backend schema or data model.
nonGoals: Adding new aarti entries or content.
Changes to any section other than Aarti.
